proposed_decisions: **P-W2-02-R4: W2-54's fence cases contradict W2-02's merged types.**
(1) Context: DEC-872 runs W2-02's resume so that every close gets the `close` type. W2-54 (in progress, close pending) took W2-02's `audit-report` lines, and its KPI S4 says "nothing of W2-02's other types". That KPI is tested by three acceptance cases and one unit test.
(2) What happened: after the merge, those four cases are red in this worktree (the failures are under tests). Everything else is green or a listed red, and `core-schema` is GREEN.
(3) Why it matters: W2-02's close runs W2-54's suite and `tests/unit`, so it would be refused. W2-54's close needs W2-02 merged, then hits the same four cases. Neither ticket can close as things stand, and every close in the wave stays blocked on the `close` type.
(4) Options:
- (a) Revise them in W2-02: a delegated decision names the four cases for revision, as DEC-746 did for W1-26. A fresh independent test designer rewrites the three W2-54 acceptance cases with `Rewrite-Reason: <decision>`, for example to measure W2-54's own commits instead of the tree. A product-spec worker revises the unit test, which is in `tests/unit/check/test_schema*`. Then W2-54's suite, `tests/unit` and the probe. Cost: one design batch, one small product-spec commit, one probe, about 2–3 h. Risk: W2-54's tests are changed by another ticket while W2-54 is in progress, which its close may flag.
- (b) Revise them through W2-54's own resume: W2-54's test designer rewrites S4 there and it merges to integrate; then W2-02 re-merges integrate, re-verifies and probes. Cost: one W2-54 round plus a W2-02 re-merge and full re-verification, about 3–4 h. Ownership stays clean.
- (c) `accepted_reds` entries: ruled out, because the list only shrinks (DEC-757, DEC-762, DEC-766).
(5) Classification: the reds come from a test contradiction between two tickets, not a fault in the code; nothing fails open and nothing loses work; any close is stopped, which is fail-closed. Recommendation: (b), confidence 0.65, because it keeps each ticket's tests with their owner. (a) if W2-54 cannot resume soon (confidence 0.35).
(6) It blocks W2-02's probe, DONE and close, and W2-54's close. Nothing else in this ticket is left to do. Waiting keeps every Wave 2 close refused at its own `core-schema`.
**This package blocks all of this ticket's remaining work.**
